title: ML Fundamentals
description: Core machine learning concepts for your memory palace demo.

concepts.title: Cross-validation
concepts.definition: Repeatedly splitting data into train and validation folds to estimate generalization performance.
concepts.mnemonic: Rotate the folders — each fold gets a turn in the spotlight.

concepts.title: Bias–variance tradeoff
concepts.definition: Underfitting (high bias) vs overfitting (high variance); models balance simplicity and flexibility.
concepts.mnemonic: A stiff ruler (bias) vs a wobbly rope (variance) measuring the same wall.

concepts.title: Gradient descent
concepts.definition: Iteratively update parameters by stepping opposite the loss gradient.
concepts.mnemonic: Walk down a staircase in the dark, feeling the slope with your foot.

concepts.title: Regularization
concepts.definition: Penalties (L1/L2) that shrink weights to reduce overfitting.
concepts.mnemonic: A spring pulling wild weights back toward zero.

concepts.title: Precision & recall
concepts.definition: Precision: of predicted positives, how many are correct. Recall: of actual positives, how many you find.
concepts.mnemonic: Precision is sharp aim; recall is sweeping the whole field.

concepts.title: ROC-AUC
concepts.definition: Area under the ROC curve; measures ranking quality across classification thresholds.
concepts.mnemonic: A mountain silhouette — higher area, better separator.

concepts.title: Feature engineering
concepts.definition: Creating informative inputs from raw data to help models learn patterns.
concepts.mnemonic: Polishing rough stones before building the wall.

concepts.title: Train/test leakage
concepts.definition: Information from the test set or future sneaks into training, inflating metrics.
concepts.mnemonic: A cracked pipe letting exam answers drip into study notes.

concepts.title: K-fold CV
concepts.definition: Split data into k parts; each part serves once as validation while the rest train.
concepts.mnemonic: k slices of pie — everyone gets a slice as dessert.

concepts.title: Hyperparameters
concepts.definition: Settings chosen before training (learning rate, tree depth) rather than learned from data.
concepts.mnemonic: Knobs on an amp — not the song, but they shape the sound.

concepts.title: Ensemble methods
concepts.definition: Combine multiple models (bagging, boosting) for stronger, stabler predictions.
concepts.mnemonic: A choir of models — one voice might waver, the chorus holds.

concepts.title: Overfitting
concepts.definition: Model memorizes training noise and fails on new data.
concepts.mnemonic: A statue wrapped in vines — detail everywhere, shape lost.

concepts.title: Embeddings
concepts.definition: Dense vector representations that capture semantic similarity between items.
concepts.mnemonic: Stars in a constellation — close stars mean similar meaning.

concepts.title: Loss function
concepts.definition: Scalar score the optimizer minimizes to measure prediction error.
concepts.mnemonic: A thermometer for wrongness — the model tries to cool it down.

concepts.title: Learning rate
concepts.definition: Step size for parameter updates; too large diverges, too small crawls.
concepts.mnemonic: Stride length on that dark staircase — not too giant, not baby steps forever.
